main_argument_chains.claim: The report count can be forecast once it is made stationary.
support_steps: The raw series fails the ADF test.
One difference and a cut at May 16 make it pass.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: March 31, 2023 is given two intervals and an expected value.

main_argument_chains.claim: Today's word does not set today's hard-mode share.
support_steps: The player does not know the word when choosing.
The lags of the share dominate the weights.
The lags of the attributes come second.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: The share is attributed to its own past.

main_argument_chains.claim: The seven shares are better predicted jointly, and synthetic data hurts.
support_steps: The shares pass the white noise test.
MMoE keeps the training and validation errors close.
CTGAN lowers both models and OpenFE helps only one.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: MMoE with feature engineering is kept, and EERIE is given seven shares.
